description: Machine-checkable statements that README.md, docs/ROADMAP.md and docs/PLAYTEST_PROTOCOL.md must keep (X3 truth patch and H6 protocol, docs/RC_PHASE1_AUDIT_AND_PLAN.md sections 9.10 and 9.12). Intended for a later qmg_docs_claims CTest. Changing a claim needs the same review as changing the docs.
vibestudio: VibeStudio: README.md is kept as docs/UPSTREAM_README.md with its links repointed, so the README claims read that file and expect the repointed links.

semantics.file: Path relative to the repository root, read as UTF-8 with LF line endings.
semantics.expect: 'match': re.search(regex, text) must find a match. 'no_match': it must find none.
semantics.regex: Python re syntax. Inline flags such as (?m), (?s) and (?i) are part of the regex.
semantics.count_source: Optional. The match's named group 'count' must equal the length of the JSON array at json_pointer (RFC 6901) in file.
semantics.controls: Every string in controls.match must match the regex and every string in controls.no_match must not. They prove the regex can both pass and fail.
